card.name: Small words in opioid label sentences
card.fires_on: Small connecting words (otherwise, if, the, as, has) in opioid drug-label sentences. Most often "otherwise" after "greater than" and "if" after a tablet name.

modes.label: "otherwise" after greater than
modes.description: The word "otherwise" in the phrase "greater than otherwise expected" about respiratory depression.
modes.example: respiratory depression that may be greater than<< otherwise>> expected and decrease the dosage of Hydrocod

modes.label: "if" after a product name
modes.description: The word "if" right after a tablet name in a discontinue instruction.
modes.example: Discontinue Codeine Sulfate Tablets<< if>> serotonin syndrome is suspected.

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Short words such as "the", "has" or "as" that sit before a key clinical term.
modes.example: may obscure<< the>> diagnosis or clinical course in patients with acute
